§6Polymer§f

§aWithout this plastic, the cracking tower stays locked. Get polymer flowing.§f

Polymer is a synthetic plastic and the gate material for the §bCatalytic Cracking Tower§f. Once you crack oil, the entire petrochemical chain opens up.

§6Crafting (Chemical Plant)§f:
§e500mB§f §bPetroleum Gas§f + §e2× Coal Powder§f + §e1× Fluorite§f → §e1× Polymer Bar§f

You can also smelt §bPlastic Scraps§f found through exploration for polymer without setting up oil refining.

§6What It Unlocks§f:
§b• Catalytic Cracking Tower§f: The big one. Unlocks cracked oil chains, natural gas processing, and way more output options.
§b• Insulators§f: §e1× Polymer Bar§f → §e8× Insulators§f for electronics.
§b• Electric Tools§f: Combine with §bHigh-Speed Steel§f for advanced tools.

§ePS:§f §bPetroleum Gas§f can also come from §bSchist Strata§f mining. If you save polymer for the cracking tower, you can skip parts of early oil refining.
